description: Nawagaththegama Pradeshiya Sabha - The List of Roads and Thoroughfares Owned by the Nawagaththegama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the declaration of certain roads and thoroughfares as being owned and maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha (local government authority). It includes detailed schedules with land coordinates, measurements, and legal provisions regarding land ownership claims and vesting of property rights to the local government. The content focuses on land registration, property boundaries, and the transfer of land rights, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
